newsitem.title: UK: Reg Vardy appoints new chief executive.
newsitem.headline: Reg Vardy appoints new chief executive.

text.p: Specialist and volume motor vehicle distributor Reg Vardy Plc said managing director Graeme Potts was appointed chief executive, taking over per today from Peter Vardy who combined the post with his position as chairman.
"I have decided that the time is right to split the roles of chairman and chief executive," said Peter Vardy at the company's annual shareholders' meeting.
"Our plans for further growth in motor retailing and associated businesses necessitate and enlarged management structure," he added.
Potts has been with Reg Vardy for nearly 14 years and has been managing director since 1988.
Peter Vardy said he will retain a full time role, concentrating on strategy, acquisitions and new business developments.
